project.objective: Determine why Michael Sheahan relocated to Schuylkill County, Pennsylvania around 1882

questions.question: Did Michael Sheahan's residence and occupation in Schuylkill County corroborate the coal-mining-relocation hypothesis?
questions.rationale: A plan is already active for this question with two planned items targeting record types that could directly corroborate residence and occupation in the coal region during the relocation window.

items.rationale: The 1880 census is the closest federal enumeration to the 1882 directory listing already in hand -- it can independently confirm occupation ('miner') and residence in Schuylkill County during the relocation window.

A parish membership or sacramental record independently corroborates residence in the coal region during the relocation window, from a source unrelated to the census. Pennsylvania, Church and Town Records, 1708-1985 (collectionId 1401638) covers this county and period.
